title: SAEM: Stage-Aware Expert Management for Memory-Efficient MoE Inference in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.21614v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting improves LLM reasoning by decomposing complex problems into intermediate steps, but its sequential nature increases decoding latency and memory usage. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale capacity through sparse expert activation, yet their full expert weights often exceed GPU memory and require costly GPU-CPU transfers. Existing runtimes treat all tokens uniformly, overlooking a key structural property of CoT traces: consecutive reasoning stages exhibit coherent and predictable expert activation patterns. Ignoring this stage-level regularity leads to inefficient caching and unnecessary data movement. We propose SAEM, a stage-aware MoE inference runtime that detects reasoning stage boundaries and exploits stage-level activation coherence to guide expert placement. SAEM combines stage-aware caching, expert-aligned token repacking, and in-situ CPU execution to reduce data transfer and kernel fragmentation.

translated_title: SAEM：阶段感知的专家管理，用于思维链推理中内存高效的MoE推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21614v1 公告类型：新 摘要：思维链（CoT）提示通过将复杂问题分解为中间步骤来提升大语言模型的推理能力，但其顺序性增加了解码延迟和内存使用。混合专家（MoE）模型通过稀疏专家激活来扩展容量，然而其完整的专家权重常常超出GPU内存，需要昂贵的GPU-CPU数据传输。现有运行时对所有标记统一处理，忽略了CoT轨迹的一个关键结构特性：连续的推理阶段表现出连贯且可预测的专家激活模式。忽略这种阶段级规律性会导致缓存效率低下和不必要的数据移动。我们提出SAEM，一种阶段感知的MoE推理运行时，它检测推理阶段的边界，并利用阶段级激活连贯性来指导专家放置。SAEM结合了阶段感知缓存、专家对齐的标记重打包和原位CPU执行，以减少数据传输和内核碎片化。
tldr: 本文提出SAEM，一种利用思维链推理中阶段级专家激活连贯性的MoE推理运行时，通过阶段感知缓存、专家对齐重打包和原位CPU执行，显著减少GPU-CPU数据传输和内核碎片化，提升内存效率和推理性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SAEM, a stage-aware MoE inference runtime that exploits stage-level expert activation coherence in chain-of-thought reasoning, combining stage-aware caching, expert-aligned repacking, and in-situ CPU execution to reduce GPU-CPU data transfer and kernel fragmentation, enhancing memory efficiency and inference performance.
